pages.content:
Co-Innovation @ Metadesign
Cutting-edge technologies | Skilled professionals | Out of the box Ideas | Collaboration
By the Industry, For the Industry
At MetaDesign Solutions, we build next-gen services and products through collaborations with industry leaders, with government bodies, with technology firms and with ecosystem participants. By creating offerings in a ‘by the industry and for the industry approach’, we deliver significant value to our clients in terms of new product development and business growth. The solutions encompass software platforms, applications, and multidimensional products in the ‘phygital' spaces. What’s more, we offer both project-based and service-oriented solutions via single or multi-tenant options.
We co-innovate with the leading firms and businesses that are ambitious and seek to create new products and services.
Together we are changing the healthcare, consumer, technology and services landscape with digital tools and products.
Innovation Labs​
Empowering Your Vision: Co-Innovate with MetaDesign Solutions
At MetaDesign Solutions, we combine your innovative ideas with our technical expertise and comprehensive experience to transform visions into digital realities. With over 300 skilled professionals and two decades of success in digital product development, we are your ideal partner to navigate the complex landscape of technology. Join us in co-creating solutions that are not only viable but also revolutionary.
01/06
Harness the Power of Experience
With a robust team of over 300 skilled developers, MetaDesign Solutions offers unmatched expertise across diverse domains. Our seasoned professionals bring deep industry knowledge to your project, ensuring we not only meet but exceed your expectations with every digital product.
02/06
Diverse Expertise, Unified Vision
We pride ourselves on our collaborative work with clients from various industries, understanding unique challenges and delivering tailored solutions. Our cross-industry insights ensure that your digital products are innovative and competitive in your specific market.
03/06
Two Decades of Digital Excellence
For twenty years, MetaDesign Solutions has been at the forefront of digital product development. Our long-standing experience equips us with the foresight and knowledge to foresee market trends and navigate technological evolutions effectively.
04/06
Cutting-Edge Technology at Your Fingertips
Staying ahead of technology curves is our specialty. We constantly adapt to emerging technologies and understand their practical benefits, ensuring that your product is built on the most advanced and suitable platform.
05/06
Comprehensive Team for Comprehensive Solutions
Our diverse team includes product designers, architects, QA specialists, business analysts, CTOs, and web security experts. Whatever your need, we have the right expert to address it, ensuring a holistic approach to your digital product development.
06/06
Expanding Horizons Together
Startups and product owners often face limitations in perspective and resources. At MetaDesign Solutions, we bring a wealth of experience and alternative approaches, expanding your horizons and enriching your projects with our broad spectrum of skills and insights.
Innovation AREAS IN Focus
No-code or Low-code Engineering
Content Solutions
Cloud Computing and Migration
Data Analytics and Business Intelligence
Cybersecurity and Risk Management
Automation with AI/ML
Internet of Things (IoT) Integration
Innovation THUS FAR
01
Next-gen patient engagement platform that transformed care delivery
We enhanced the care delivery value chain with a next-gen patient engagement platform for a leading Health services firm. Working in collaboration with a leading tier-I care services provider in South Asia, we designed, developed, deployed, and operate the platform through a pay-as-you-use model.
Our solution featured multi-modes of communication (text, voice, video), a diverse mix of consultation services, and third-party integrations that connected to external, extended services seamlessly.
Know more about [Medanta e-clinic]
02
A no-code platform that transforms the development of apps and websites
We conceived, designed, and deployed a no-code platform to enhance the speed of software creation. Our mission is to democratize software development by enabling non-technical individuals to build applications and automate processes, fostering innovation and increasing productivity. As a result, users can create applications and workflows via a simple WYSIWYG editor, without code.
Try [CodeNula]
03
A CME events platform for medsci learning and educational programs
We built a low-code based, single instance, multi-event hosting solution that allows the planning, creation, & management of medical events (hybrid – virtual and in-person), with the appropriate media support for video-conferences and the delivery of pre-during-post event services and information such as, distribution of self-learning contents. The application offers paced interactions with comprehensive content management of interactive and pre-recorded learning videos, quizzes and Q&As.
Operational management of all event services (ex. registrations, payments workflows and all other user services), participant communications, responses and polls are also tracked and delivered by the application.
Know more about [MediquestEvents - MQE]
04
A seamless cloud platform for laboratory-kits QMS and distribution
We designed and developed a cloud-based supply chain and distribution platform for a leading manufacturer and supplier of device kits. The solution addressed both online and offline business operations and featured multiple data-driven workflow services.  The service seamlessly connected distributors and manufacturers, thereby ensuring better support for the laboratory services.
Know more about [Pathkits]
05
A next-gen platform for personalized content delivery
Our cutting-edge education platform built for marketing teams offers an array of learning resources and trending news. Created onto a private cloud model, it is deployed for CPG and pharma use cases.
This platform enables marketers, salespeople, and education providers deliver personalized content to care professionals on their digital devices.
Harnessing the power of content syndication and APIs, our platform is customized for  – it effortlessly adapts to various content marketing strategies. It can be easily plugged into new emerging online content businesses too.
Try our [Services]
06
Timely digital platform for seamless COVID-19 kit delivery
We collaborated with a leading healthcare service provider, a diagnostics Laboratory, and helped them overcome the challenges posed by the COVID-19 pandemic lockdowns via digital solutions.
Our solutions increased the efficiency and scale of the lab’s COVID-19 kit distribution. As a result, they were able to transform its services and enhance effectiveness during the recent years.
Know more about [MolQ]
07
Transforming cybersecurity recruitment using GenAI
CyberforceHQ revolutionizes the cybersecurity hiring landscape by streamlining the recruitment process with a focus on validated skills and practical experience using GenAI led automation of content aggregation and processing.
This platform enables organizations to efficiently identify and engage top-tier cybersecurity talent, ensuring swift and precise recruitment, which significantly enhances organizational security capabilities and supports dynamic workforce scaling. By transforming traditional recruitment methods, CyberforceHQ facilitates a quicker adaptation to evolving cybersecurity challenges and improves the strategic deployment of skilled professionals.
Know more about [Cyberforce HQ]

To know more about the work we do for innovation firms and startups, click here .   These are merely a few of the  innovations  in business processes and technology solutions which have seen the light of day and adoption by our customers or offered by us to the marketplace. Join us at the forefront of  innovation .

pages.content:
Privacy Policy
Privacy Policy
Our Objective:
Here at MetaDesign Solutions we take your privacy extremely seriously. Any personal data
shared with or collected by us is protected using sophisticated encryption techniques. We do not, under any
circumstance, share your data with any 3rd Party without prior consent or notification. We believe that Trust
and Privacy are fundamental to the growth of any business relationship.
MetaDesign Solutions is a software development company that provides Development Services for a multitude of
Technologies. While it’s main base of operations is in Gurugram, Haryana in the close vicinity of the capital of
India, MetaDesign Solutions has sales offices in the United States of America, Canada and
Australia.
Information security and Privacy are a continuously evolving responsibility therefore we will keep
updating our Privacy Policy whenever needed.
How we process and collect Personal Data:
Personal Information is any data which relates to an individual who may be identified from
that data, or from a combination of a set of data and other information which is or may be in possession of
MetaDesign Solutions.
In general, you may browse our website without providing any personal information about
yourself. However, certain information such as your IP Address, Demographic, your device’ Operating System and
browser type may be collected in order to provide better usability, troubleshooting, site maintenance, and to
understand which parts of the website are visited and how frequently.
When you register on our website or would like to comment on our content, we may require you
to provide us with certain Personal Information such as your name, email address, designation, company, country
and contact number for one or more of the following purposes: user ID creation, identifying and contacting you
about providing you with access to desirable content based on your preferences.
You may choose to give us personal information such as your name and address of email ID that
may be needed for example, to correspond with you and for you to download material such as our case studies,
white papers etc. We intend to protect the quality and integrity of your personally identifiable information.
MetaDesign Solutions will not be liable to any unsolicited information provided by you. You
consent to MetaDesign Solutions using any information provided by you as per our privacy policy.
MetaDesign Solutions Cookie usage:
Our website uses cookies and by visiting our website, you agree that cookies can be stored on
your device as explained below.
Cookies serve many purposes, but mainly, they enable you to navigate between pages easily,
remember your preferences, and eventually improve your user experience. Cookies stored on your device can help
identify your computer. Cookies used on this website can be set up by our website or via a 3rd-party.
Furthermore, Cookies can be “session” cookies which are stored only for the duration of the current session or
“persistent” cookies that remains stored on the user’s device until it expires.
You may opt-out of cookies via your browser settings.
MetaDesign Solutions may email you regarding updates to our privacy and security policies
should they be undertaken.

Data and Analytics Services
Future-proof your business with metadesign's cutting-edge data and analytics services
Data is a key element of every business that operates, be it their strategy or be it in operations.
The enterprises we work for intend to realize value from their business data (of consumers, employees, partners) and seek to put data & analytics to work for them. The careful effort in the high quality data-capture, its storage & analysis and the capabilities in doing this are unique advantages to leverage into higher growth.
We provide these solutions and services keeping the business impact and outcomes in mind as data services are fundamentally about decisions and improved business operations and transactions.
At Metadesign, our data and analytics solutions empower enterprises to harness the full potential of their data. We utilize advanced analytics tools and technologies to deliver insights that drive strategic decisions and optimize operations.
Our Data and Analytics Services & Solutions
We assist organizations with their data and analytics projects, as these form the basis of the digital transformation fuelled by the emerging dynamic of digital devices, connected consumers, businesses and the marketplace ecosystems.
Analytics
To get actionable insights, to make decisions, to optimize your operations and achieve consistent growth in the market and to build the basis for the future, Analytics is a key aspect of business performance and improvement.
Data Engineering
Data, processing related to the organization of data into a format useful to make informed decisions constitutes much of the work in engineering, this includes design, build and deployment of Data Mart/Data Lake/Data Warehouse, Database Design and Performance, Data Pipelines (ETL, ELT), Data Quality and Management
Data Governance
Data governance ensures that data management aligns with organizational policies and regulatory requirements, promoting data integrity, security, and privacy. Effective governance practices are essential for maintaining high-quality data that supports informed decision-making and compliance.
Business Intelligence
Business intelligence taps into the data to generate actionable insights. We build the logic optimized queries, the APIs, the UIs and the visual interfaces and user interaction design to analyze and deliver the information for self-service analytics, chatbots and event driven actions, through discovery and preparation of data for the business analysis and BI presentation.
Cloud Data Solutions
Adopting cloud data solutions allows for scalable, flexible, and cost-effective data management. Cloud platforms provide the infrastructure needed to store, process, and analyze large volumes of data efficiently.
Machine Learning and AI Integration
Leveraging machine learning (ML) and artificial intelligence (AI) can transform raw data into predictive insights, driving innovation and competitive advantage. Our expertise in ML and AI enables businesses to harness the power of advanced analytics and automation.

pages.content:
Android Launch Mode: Understanding Activity Behavior in Mobile App Development
By
Amit Gupta
/
Launch mode is an Android OS command that determines how an activity should be started. It specifies how every new action should be linked to the existing task . In Android, an app can have multiple tasks, and activities can behave differently based on their launch mode. There are four launch modes for activity:
Standard
SingleTop
SingleTask
SingleInstance
Master Android Launch Modes
Looking to improve your app’s navigation and task management? Schedule a call with our experts to explore how launch modes can improve your Android app’s user experience.
Inquire Now
Back Stack
Figure 1: A representation of how each new activity in a task adds an item to the back stack . When the user presses or gestures Back, the current activity is destroyed, and the previous activity resumes.
1. Standard Launch Mode
This is the default launch mode of an activity. If you don’t set any launch mode for your activity, it will use the standard mode by default. This mode creates a new instance of the activity every time, even if the activity instance is already present in the task .
Suppose we have activities A , B , C , and D , and your activity B has standard launch mode. If we launch activity B again:
State of Activity Stack Before Launch B:
css
Copy code
A → B → C → D
State of Activity Stack After Launch B:
css
Copy code
A → B → C → D → B
As we can see, a new instance of B is created again, resulting in multiple tasks .
Syntax:
xml
Copy code
<activity android:launchMode="standard" />
2. SingleTop Launch Mode
If an instance of an activity already exists at the top of the current task , a new instance will not be created, and the Android system will route the intent information through the onNewIntent() method.
If the instance is not at the top of the task , a new instance will be created.
For example, if we have the activity stack as A → B → C → D , and we launch C , a new instance of C will be created because it’s not at the top.
mathematica
Copy code
State before launch C: A → B → C → D
State after launch C: A → B → C → D → C
Now, suppose we have A → B → C → D → C , and we launch C again. In this case, C is already at the top, so instead of creating a new instance, it will receive the intent data through the onNewIntent() method.
Syntax:
xml
Copy code
<activity android:launchMode="singleTop" />
3. SingleTask Launch Mode
An activity declared with launch mode as singleTask can have only one instance in the system (like a singleton ). At a time, only one instance of the activity will exist.
If the activity instance is not present, a new instance will be created, and if the instance is already present in the system, the onNewIntent() method will receive the callback.
For example, if we have A → B → C and launch D (with singleTask ), a new instance of D will be created. The activity stack will look like this:
css
Copy code
A → B → C → D
Now, if we launch B (which also has singleTask ), the stack will look like:
css
Copy code
A → B
Here, the old instance of B is used, and the onNewIntent() method will handle the intent data. Additionally, C and D are destroyed in this case.
This behavior is particularly useful when we want to ensure that certain activities, like the root activity , are only created once and prevent the app from creating multiple tasks .
Syntax:
xml
Copy code
<activity android:launchMode="singleTask" />
Figure 2. A representation of how an activity with launch mode "singleTask" is added to the back stack. If the activity is already a part of a background task with its own back stack, then the entire back stack also comes forward, on top of the current task.
4. SingleInstance Launch Mode
This is similar to singleTask , except that no other activities will be created in the same task . If another activity is launched from this kind of activity, a new task will automatically be created to place that new activity in.
Case 1:
If we have activities A → B → C , and D has singleInstance launch mode, launching D will create a new task for it. The tasks will look like this:
arduino
Copy code
Task 1: A → B → C
Task 2: D
Now, if we launch E from A → B → C , the stack will look like:
mathematica
Copy code
Task 1: A → B → C → E
Task 2: D
Case 2:
If A → B → C is in one task and D is in another task with singleInstance , launching D again will call the existing instance of D and route intent data through the onNewIntent() method:
arduino
Copy code
Task 1: A → B → C
Task 2: D
Syntax:
xml
Copy code
<activity android:launchMode="singleInstance" />
Task Affinity and Multiple Tasks
In Android, the taskAffinity attribute allows you to assign a specific affinity to an activity, which determines in which task the activity should reside. By setting taskAffinity , Android developers can control which activities share the same task, helping create a better user experience when navigating through the app.
When a new activity is launched, the taskAffinity value is checked to determine whether the new activity should be part of an existing task or if a new task should be created. This feature is particularly important when dealing with singleTask and singleInstance launch modes.
State Restoration and Navigation
A key consideration for Android developers is how to handle state restoration when navigating between different tasks. For example, when activities are recreated or brought back to the foreground, developers need to manage how the state of these activities is restored to provide a seamless user experience.
By using launch modes like singleTask and singleInstance , you can ensure that only a single instance of an activity exists across tasks, reducing redundancy and improving the efficiency of the app. The onNewIntent() method plays a crucial role in restoring the state of an activity when it is relaunched.
Conclusion
As we explore the intricacies of Android launch modes and their impact on app development, it’s also important to consider the broader landscape of cross-platform solutions. In the realm of mobile app development, technologies like Flutter and React Native are changing the game, offering developers the tools to build high-performance, visually appealing applications for both Android and iOS from a single codebase. By leveraging these powerful frameworks, our team ensures that your app delivers a seamless user experience, regardless of the platform.

Custom EMR/EHR Systems for Hospitals: Benefits, Cost & Key Integrations
By
Girish Sagar
/
Introduction
Why EMR/EHR Systems Are the Backbone of Modern Hospitals
Electronic Medical Records (EMR) and Electronic Health Records (EHR) systems have transformed how hospitals manage clinical workflows, patient data, and compliance. While off-the-shelf EMR tools offer generic features, they often fall short when it comes to department-specific workflows , custom integrations , and AI-powered decision support . This is why hospitals are turning to custom healthcare software development companies to build tailor-made EMR/EHR platforms that address their unique operational, clinical, and compliance needs. In this detailed guide, we cover:
What EMR/EHR systems do
Key benefits of custom-built solutions
Critical system integrations
Real-world examples
Cost estimates and development timelines
EMR vs. EHR: What’s the Difference?

EHR

For hospitals, EHR systems offer broader functionality , especially when integrated across departments, specialties, and external labs or pharmacies.

The Role of AI in Custom EHR Systems
AI is revolutionizing the EMR/EHR space by introducing intelligence into clinical and operational workflows.

Predictive Diagnosis: Flag potential chronic diseases based on symptom trends
Voice-to-Text Input: Faster and hands-free clinical documentation
Smart Alerts: Notify physicians of abnormal lab results or vital signs

Compliance and Data Security Considerations
A custom healthcare system must align with the following standards:
HIPAA – U.S. data protection regulation for health information
HL7/FHIR – Data formats for interoperability across health systems
GDPR – For handling patient data of EU citizens
Role-Based Access & Audit Trails – Mandatory for clinical data systems
MetaDesign Solutions ensures compliance is built into every layer of development, from architecture to deployment.
Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)
1. Is it better to build or buy EMR/EHR software?
Build if:
You want full control and customization
Need to support unique workflows or languages
Require flexible integrations and AI
Buy if:
You need a plug-and-play solution with basic features
You're a small clinic with limited resources
2. How long will it take to train hospital staff?
With a custom-designed user interface and onboarding workflows, training takes 1–2 weeks , and adoption rates are high due to intuitive role-based dashboards.
3. Will my system work offline or on low internet?
Yes. We can enable offline-first features with auto-sync for mobile or remote clinics that operate in bandwidth-constrained areas.

Custom EMR/EHR systems are no longer optional—they're the foundation for scalable, data-driven, patient-centric healthcare . Partnering with a leading European publisher, we deployed custom AI ML solutions for real-time live stream analysis and alteration. Our fault-tolerant pipeline ensures minimal delay, highlighting our AI and ML implementation services for demanding enterprise needs.
The Challenge:
A prominent European publisher required the capability to dynamically analyze and modify their live video streams as they were being broadcast. This was a complex task involving more than just basic processing; it demanded sophisticated AI/ML models capable of understanding specific content elements within the stream in real-time. The crucial constraints were applying these AI-driven alterations with significant speed to ensure minimal, imperceptible delay for viewers, and building a system robust enough to be fault-tolerant for 24/7 live operation. Achieving this balance between real-time performance, complex AI execution, and high reliability presented a significant technical hurdle.
The Solution:
MetaDesign Solutions engineered and implemented a cutting-edge, fault-tolerant pipeline designed specifically for low-latency live stream processing. This involved developing and integrating special-tuned AI/ML models capable of analyzing the live video feed frame-by-frame and making rapid, intelligent decisions based on the publisher's requirements. Our machine learning services for enterprises enabled us to create these bespoke models, while our expertise in AI and ML implementation services ensured seamless integration into the live broadcast workflow. The pipeline was architected for high throughput and minimal buffering, allowing the system to process, alter, and re-stream content with unprecedented speed and reliability, acting as a true AI powered business solution.
The Technology:
The core of our solution was a meticulously designed real-time data processing pipeline. This architecture utilized advanced streaming protocols and parallel processing techniques to ensure ultra-low latency. We developed and deployed custom AI/ML models tailored precisely to the publisher's unique content analysis and modification needs. The system incorporated robust monitoring and automated failover mechanisms to ensure the pipeline remained operational and fault-tolerant around the clock, a necessity for critical live broadcast infrastructure.
The Results & Impact:

headings.text: AI Video Editor: Transforming long videos into short clips with Flutter

pages.content:
By
Sukriti Srivastava
/
AI Video Editor: Transforming long videos into short clips with Flutter
Overview
AI Video Editor is a desktop application developed to convert long videos or movies into short clips for platforms like YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, and TikTok.
about the client
The client required a user-friendly and efficient software solution that supports Windows, macOS, and Linux platforms for high-performance video editing tasks.
Client's Problem
The client needed a cross-platform desktop application capable of converting long videos into shorter clips efficiently. The application had to run seamlessly on multiple operating systems without maintaining separate codebases, handle large video files, and provide quick processing times.
Industry Domain
Technology and Media
Service Category (Service-line)
Digital Platform/Product EngineeringServices
Technologies Used
Flutter
Challenges
During development, several challenges were encountered, including the creation of a cross-platform application that could seamlessly run on Windows, macOS, and Linux. Managing the complexities of video editing tasks proved particularly difficult, especially when handling large video files that demanded significant processing power and memory. Additionally, integrating AI to ensure high-quality and relevant video output introduced further complexities, requiring careful calibration and optimization to meet the desired performance standards while maintaining efficiency across different platforms.
These challenges were overcome by adopting a strategic approach that involved several key steps. First, the team utilized Flutter to develop a single codebase that could be used across all platforms, ensuring consistency and efficiency in the development process. They also focused on core features such as video trimming, splitting, and conversion, prioritizing the essential functionalities that users would find most valuable. Additionally, advanced AI algorithms were employed to enhance both the quality and relevance of the videos, ensuring that the end product met high standards and delivered a superior user experience.
Solution Scope and Services
Approach taken: The AI Video Editor was developed using Flutter, enabling the creation of a single codebase that supports multiple desktop platforms. This approach streamlined the development process, ensuring a consistent user experience across different devices.
Implementation details: The development team focused on creating a robust application that incorporated essential features like video trimming, splitting, and conversion. The integration of AI ensured high-quality output by automating key video editing tasks, making the editor both powerful and user-friendly. The combination of these technologies resulted in a streamlined and consistent video editing experience across multiple desktop platforms.
Below are technologies and tools used (tech stack):
01
Flutter SDK
Utilized for cross-platform development, the Flutter SDK allowed the application to run seamlessly on various desktop platforms, including Windows, macOS, and Linux. By leveraging Flutter's rich set of pre-built widgets and tools, the development team was able to create a visually appealing and responsive user interface that maintained consistent performance across different devices. This significantly reduced development time and effort by eliminating the need to write separate codebases for each platform.
02
Dart programming language
Employed for coding the application, Dart provided an efficient and reliable development environment, known for its fast compilation and ease of use. The language’s strong support for asynchronous programming and rich standard library enabled the development team to handle complex tasks such as real-time video processing and AI integrations with greater efficiency. Additionally, Dart's integration with Flutter allowed for a smooth workflow, ensuring that the code remained clean, maintainable, and scalable as the application evolved.
03
AI algorithms
Integrated for advanced functionalities, AI algorithms played a critical role in enhancing the video editing experience. These algorithms were used for tasks such as scene detection, content analysis, and audio processing, which allowed the application to intelligently identify key moments in videos and optimize them for better quality and relevance. The AI-driven features not only automated tedious editing tasks but also improved the overall output by ensuring that videos were processed with precision and accuracy, resulting in a professional-grade editing experience for users.
04
FFmpeg
Used for video processing tasks, FFmpeg was instrumental in enabling efficient video trimming, splitting, and conversion. This powerful multimedia framework allowed the application to handle a wide range of video formats and resolutions, ensuring compatibility and high performance. By integrating FFmpeg, the development team was able to offer users a robust set of editing tools that could process videos quickly and with minimal resource usage, even when dealing with large files or high-definition content. This ensured that the application remained responsive and capable of delivering high-quality results, regardless of the complexity of the video editing tasks.
Results
Outcomes and benefits for the client:
Successful operation on Windows, macOS, and Linux platforms.
Efficient conversion of long videos into short clips.
Seamless and consistent user experience across all supported operating systems.
Metrics or KPIs to show success:
25% reduction in development and maintenance costs.
15% faster video processing times.
Increased user satisfaction due to high-quality and relevant video outputs.
Summary of the project’s impact: Developing the AI Video Editor with Flutter effectively addressed the client's challenges by reducing costs, facilitating quick updates, and ensuring a consistent user experience. AI integration enhanced the software's capability to deliver high-quality video content, meeting the client's requirements and exceeding user expectations.

headings.text: Developing a versatile citation management add-in for Microsoft Word to streamline academic writing and enhance research collaboration for a global leader in educational and research solutions

pages.content:
By
Sukriti Srivastava
/
Developing a versatile citation management add-in for Microsoft Word to streamline academic writing and enhance research collaboration for a global leader in educational and research solutions
Overview
MetaDesign Solutions collaborated with a global leader in academic research to develop a powerful RefWorks Citation Manager (RCM) Add-in for Microsoft Word. This add-in, available via the Microsoft Office Store, provides users with seamless access to their reference collection within Word, enabling them to manage citations, footnotes, and bibliographies. With two versions developed using the Office Web Add-in SDK and Office VSTO Add-in SDK, MetaDesign Solutions enhanced both the desktop and web-based Word experiences, delivering a flexible solution that facilitates academic research and collaboration.
about the client
The client is a global leader in providing research and educational tools to academic institutions, researchers, and students worldwide. Their flagship product, a cloud-based reference management platform, is designed to simplify research workflows, manage citations, and create bibliographies efficiently. By offering features like citation style support, full-text management, and academic database integrations, the platform serves as a vital tool for academic institutions, libraries, and researchers.
One of the platform’s key strengths is its ability to streamline the research process, offering functionalities such as drag-and-drop citation management, full-text organization, and collaborative research workflows. With the client’s focus on enhancing research productivity, they required an advanced tool integrated directly into Microsoft Word to ensure that users could access their references easily while working on academic writing tasks.
Industry Domain
Professional Services and Education
Service Category (Service-line)
Word Plug-in Development / Office Plug-in Development / Digital Product Development
Technologies Used
Angular
HTML5
CSS3
Office Add-in SDK
Challenges
Seamless Integration : Integrating the add-in with both web and desktop versions of Microsoft Word using two different SDKs (Office Web and VSTO).
Real-Time Sync : Ensuring that the add-in synchronizes reference data in real-time with the user's RefWorks account.
Collaboration Support : Enabling users to collaborate on shared documents in Word Online with synchronized references.
Citation Management Complexity : Supporting multiple citation formats, footnotes, and automatic bibliography updates in a user-friendly manner.
Cross-Platform Compatibility : Ensuring the add-in operates smoothly across different platforms (Word Online, desktop, mobile).
Solution Scope and Services
MetaDesign Solutions took on the challenge of developing the RefWorks Citation Manager (RCM) add-in, which was designed to work seamlessly with Microsoft Word. The solution offered users read-only access to their RefWorks account, allowing them to add in-text citations and footnotes directly into Word documents and automatically update bibliographies. The RCM add-in syncs with the user's RefWorks database in real-time, providing quick and reliable access to reference collections while writing documents.
Two versions of the RCM were developed to cater to different user needs: one using the Office Web Add-in SDK for web-based Word access, and the other using the Office VSTO Add-in SDK for the desktop version. Both versions allowed users to work collaboratively on shared projects, ensuring that the add-in functions efficiently in Word Online when multiple contributors are involved. The add-in's intuitive interface ensures that academic writers can manage citations and bibliographies effortlessly, thus improving productivity.
01
Cross-Platform Compatibility with Microsoft Word
The add-in was developed to ensure a smooth user experience across both desktop and web versions of Microsoft Word. Using both the Office Web Add-in SDK and Office VSTO Add-in SDK, we were able to deliver a seamless solution that caters to the different needs of users on various platforms. This flexibility has enabled broader adoption among academic users, improving accessibility.
02
Real-Time Synchronization with RefWorks
The integration of real-time synchronization with the client’s cloud-based RefWorks platform ensures that users always have access to the most up-to-date reference collections. This feature not only enhances productivity but also reduces the possibility of citation errors, as users can rely on accurate reference data across multiple writing sessions.
03
Collaboration in Word Online
To facilitate group projects, the add-in enables full collaboration within Word Online. By ensuring that all contributors have synchronized access to shared RefWorks Projects, the add-in supports simultaneous editing and citation management, allowing research teams to work together efficiently without missing any critical references.
Results
MetaDesign Solutions' development of the RefWorks Citation Manager (RCM) add-in significantly enhanced the client's reference management platform by providing a robust, integrated solution for Microsoft Word users. The add-in streamlined the citation process for researchers and students, offering a user-friendly interface that supports a variety of citation styles, inline and footnote citations, and automatic bibliography updates. Additionally, the collaborative features enabled users to work on shared documents in Word Online, increasing productivity and efficiency in academic writing. This solution has empowered the client to extend the functionality of their platform, reinforcing their position as a leader in academic research tools.

pages.content:
By
Sukriti Srivastava
/
Engineering an expansive AI based solution for training customer support teams
Overview
American Firm SharperAx partnered with MetaDesign Solutions (MDS) to create a comprehensive AI Based Employee Training Platform which covered all possible training scenarios.
about the client
The services firm wanted to build a role-play automation solution that lets companies arm their sellers with consistent, relevant and compelling messages. It wanted to offer an intuitive cloud and webcam-based system that lets sellers learn from expert sellers within the organization, practice their best stories and receive coaching from managers.
Industry Domain
Professional (Sales Training/Consulting) Services
Service Category (Service-line)
Digital Platform/Product Engineering
Technologies Used
Node
MySQL
WOWZA Server
YII PHP Framework
Amazon Web Services
Challenges
The development presented several challenges that the MDS team had to overcome to meet the project’s requirements. One major challenge was ensuring that the AI sounded and acted as human-like as possible. To achieve this, the team utilized a large bank of pre-recorded answers and developed custom machine learning algorithms and AI models to provide accurate responses in real-time. Another significant challenge was implementing live AI coaching, where the AI needed to give real-time feedback on user calls, suggest best practices, and provide corrective feedback. This was successfully addressed through the creation of custom AI models and machine learning algorithms, enabling the AI to deliver effective, real-time coaching to users.
Solution Scope and Services
To ensure success, the application needed to be secure, robust, intuitive and able to handle a high volume of users. This is in addition to the requirement for the platform to be AI d riven which would give the users the impression they are communicating with a real person, both verbally and via text. The platform enables a dministrators/ m anagers to set assignments for their subordinates and be notified of their progress.
Assignments were of two types:
Practice
Via email, a trainee is assigned a practice video to watch and then to create one of their own on the same topic. To complete this task, the employee must record themselves simulating a conversation with the help of an AI bot. This bot features extremely lifelike conversation skills and is able to convey situational urgency via their tone of voice.
View Type
The trainee is asked to view a training video and then answer a survey which would then quiz their understanding of that video.
In both cases, it is possible to detect if the trainee skipped any part of the video. The survey would only be provided to the trainee if they view 100% of the video assigned to them.
01
Front-End Development
MDS developed an intuitive Front-end experience for the proposed platform primarily using JavaScript and JQuery. HTML5 was used to integrate m ultimedia recording and screen capturing facilities.
02
Back-End Development
To facilitate all the functions required by our client , a capable and robust backend was created which could sustain the platform and scale according to demand.
The BE w eb p latform/ s ite is primarily based on PHP integrated seamlessly with MySQL.
A combo of AWS Lambda and NodeJS are used for scheduling services as well as V ideo Analytics. The backbone of the AI Features is created using MS Cognitive Services.
To ensure robust security for the platform, p ersonalized Amazon services were utilized to encrypt all data.
In addition to HTML5, Webrtc, Wowza engine was utilized for multimedia recording.
Results
MetaDesign Solutions delivered a robust and intuitive platform which met each of their requirements. The p latform was subjected to extensive testing and delivered the desired performance and functionality. With MDS d evelopment services, the firm has established itself as a pioneering Sales Coaching Platform.

Overview
Metadesign Solutions (MDS) successfully created a platform for topic-based Video Discussions for this emerging business. The platform we built was for podcasters. Users may host their interactive live podcasting shows.
about the client
Established in 2017, our client brings innovation to the world of podcasting and debates with their idea of live topic-based video discussions via an app or browser.
The service allows users to have discussions in groups of upto 4 people that share common interests, often with different viewpoints, providing an engaging and rewarding experience over web and mobile.  It also helps users in growing their communities and help them in making new connections via interactive video conversations.

Technology and Media
Service Category (Service-line)
Digital Platform/Product Engineering (Video Chat/Conferencing) Services
Technologies Used
MongoDB, Node
Amazon Web Services (AWS)
Angular
Android
iOS
Challenges
Ensuring security and overall stability, reliability and performance.
Building a highly reliable and consistent service for podcasting and interactive video.
Videos were recorded using a custom HLS streaming service and were of a lower quality than that was required in the case of a 4-user combined stream scenario. The MDS team resolved the issue successfully by building sockets to hold connections and sustain them.
Low bandwidth connections in discussions with 4 users generated an issue where users would unexpectedly drop out of rooms. MDS created a bespoke module which successfully resolved the issue.
Solution Scope and Services
The service was required to be completely functional even on devices connected to poor quality networks with a large user base being able to enjoy seamless video discussions and with an even larger set of users having the ability to watch discussions in progress as well.
Keeping the client’s directives in mind, MetaDesign designed the application to be lightweight yet feature-rich and intuitive for a user to onboard and interact with the service.
Services delivered by us included –
01
Web FE (frontend) Development
MDS developed an intuitive and lightweight web platform from which users taking full advantage of Angular 4 to create a robust and fluid front-end experience on both desktop and mobile web browsers. The front-end was linked seamlessly to Opentok, which controls audio and video streaming.  Firebase was utilized to push notifications and real-time data transfers.
02
Mobile Development
To ensure the clients’ requirements for an easily accessible Video Discussion Platform were met, the application required a two-pronged approach for the mobile segment.
Mobile apps were created for Android and iOS platforms utilizing Native Android app Development and Native iOS
app development which ensured a seamless, robust and user-friendly experience.
This was augmented with a powerful and mobile-friendly website which could allow users to drop into video
discussions without downloading the app, which further removed barriers to entry.
03
Backend Development
To ensure that the service which is a traffic and bandwidth-heavy video platform ran smoothly even under stress, we developed a robust backend framework which could effortlessly support high volumes of VoIP communication. utilizing NodeJS, Express, and MongoDB. Firebase was used to optimize data transfer. This combination of technologies was stress-tested to ensure a robust and scalable backend which would effortlessly support the service.
Results
Metadesign Solutions team successfully delivered to scope of the video based digital product here, in a collaborative product engineering model, in an agile approach working iteratively to overcome all developmental hurdles along the way and delivering a feature and function rich, responsive and user-friendly communication platform for our customer.
The platform provides an extensive reach making it quick and easy to join in discussions and spread one’s views or view discussions in progress and gain an insight into what people are thinking about globally. To enable such a solution to continually operate and deliver to users, we are the ongoing partner to enable continuous digital product development and support services.
The service is a well accepted video-podcast service and has been in use for a few years now. It is currently undergoing a new version upgrade and platform enhancement to meet a new set of scope areas and domains.

pages.content:
By
Sukriti Srivastava

Development of a feature-rich instant contact data exchange application for a USA based services company
Overview
The company approached MetaDesign (MDS) with their requirement to craft an intuitive and feature- rich i nstant c ontact e xchange a pp. An extensive feature list was described keeping the user’s convenience in mind. Circles directive was to be able to exchange contact information instantly and thereby start a group (Circle) whether you already know someone or had just met them .
about the client
Established in the USA in 2015, the company has been at the forefront of innovation in Professional/Business Services (example, Card Exchange services) by leveraging cutting edge technology.
The firm wanted to build an innovative business card & contact information exchange application , which is available on Android and iOS devices and provides a comprehensive set of tools to the user for adding new contacts and setting up meetings.
Industry Domain
Professional Business Services
Service Category (Service-line)
Digital Product Engineering
Technologies Used
Ruby On Rails
Salesforce
Firebase
Challenges
The challenge was to create a solution which incorporates the ability to initiate contact and create circles (meetings) via Bluetooth.
The ability to share contact info via a secure code.
Create multiple profiles which could be updated even after being shared with a new contact.
Ability to create meetings with contacts.
Strict and secure privacy settings per user.
Comprehensive visiting card scanning, including being able to interpret social media profiles and collate their details accordingly, and also set meetings via this feature.
Extensive Salesforce integration – Ability to create leads from within the Circles app itself.
Set meetings via Google Maps integration – Sync your existing meetings to a location.
Solution Scope and Services
To ensure the success of the application, it was crucial to design it for maximum compatibility across devices, enabling access to a larger user base. MetaDesign Solutions approached the project with a modular development strategy, breaking down the extensive feature set into manageable segments. This not only kept the app lightweight and responsive but also made it easier to introduce new features iteratively over time, ensuring the app’s incremental viability and long-term scalability .
Key Features Integrated into app:
Salesforce Integration:  Seamlessly save new contacts as leads and sync with Salesforce.
Meeting Setup and Contact Discovery:  Easily arrange meetings or discover new contacts in the vicinity.
Business Card Scanner:  Scan photos and social media details from business cards.
Profile Management:  Create and share multiple user profiles effortlessly.
01
Modular Development
MDS employed Ruby on Rails to develop both the front-end and back-end frameworks, ensuring a fluid and robust user experience. This modular approach allowed for the seamless integration of critical features and ensured that the application remained efficient and easy to use, even as new functionalities were added. The modular architecture also enabled the app to deliver high performance and scalability.
02
Native platforms (Mobile Development)
Given the app’s reliance on mobile devices to reach a broader audience, we utilized Native Android and iOS development to ensure seamless operation on both individual platforms. This approach allowed the Ruby on Rails framework to function efficiently on mobile devices, providing users with a consistent and high-quality experience regardless of their device.
03
Integrations and Realtime Notifications
To enhance the app’s functionality, Salesforce SDK was integrated into the application , allowing users to create leads directly within the app and sync them with their existing Salesforce accounts. Additionally, Firebase was utilized to enable real-time push notifications, alerting users to nearby meetings or potential new contacts. These features were seamlessly integrated into the modular architecture, ensuring a cohesive and powerful user experience.
Results
MetaDesign Solutions delivered a comprehensive contact exchange app to the customer , whilst successfully overcoming multiple hurdles faced during development. The app delivered was to spec, intuitive, scalable and reliable and is a useful tool for those looking to further their connections with like-minded professionals or individuals they meet , be it at a restaurant or at a conference.

Leveraging Salesforce Apex for Custom Solutions

pages.content:
By
Pooja Makkar
/
Enhancing healthcare efficiency through seamless integration of Salesforce and patient management systems, delivering automation, synchronization, and improved accuracy for a leading health technology provider
Overview
MetaDesign Solutions successfully developed a Salesforce integration module for a leading health technology provider specializing in direct primary care and concierge practices. This module automated the synchronization between their Salesforce CRM and patient management system, eliminating manual syncing errors and enabling real-time data updates. The solution allowed the healthcare provider to enhance its operational efficiency, allowing more time to focus on patient care by streamlining administrative tasks and ensuring data consistency across platforms.
about the client
The client, a leading health technology provider, offers comprehensive membership management and billing software tailored for direct primary care and concierge medical practices. Their flagship product streamlines the operational workflows of thousands of healthcare providers nationwide, with features such as automated billing, invoicing, and patient data integration.
They further empower healthcare practices through advanced tools that manage patient scheduling, electronic forms, and other clinical operations. Recognizing the need for seamless data flow between systems, the client sought a robust solution to connect their Salesforce CRM with their patient management system, ensuring synchronized, accurate data across both platforms. With this integration, they aimed to eliminate errors caused by manual input and provide healthcare practices with a more streamlined operational experience.
Industry Domain
Allied Healthcare (TPAs, BA, Billing)
Service Category (Service-line)
Salesforce Development / Digital Product Development
Technologies Used
Salesforce
Salesforce Apex
Javascript
Challenges
Data Synchronization :The client needed a solution to sync Salesforce contacts with patient records in their own system, ensuring real-time updates.
Manual Errors : Reducing the reliance on manual data entry, which often led to discrepancies between the two systems.
Batch Processing : Ensuring large volumes of patient and contact records could be processed efficiently, without performance slowdowns.
Data Accuracy : Addressing data conflicts during syncing to ensure the most current and correct information was reflected on both platforms.
User-Friendly : Creating an intuitive interface that allowed administrators to sync and manage patient data without extensive technical knowledge.
Solution Scope and Services
MetaDesign Solutions developed a robust Salesforce to patient management system integration module, leveraging the Salesforce API , Salesforce Apex programming language , and JavaScript for the front-end. The module facilitated both manual and batch synchronization of contacts from Salesforce to the client’s patient system, with automatic detection and resolution of demographic matches. When no match was found, the system allowed for creating new patient records directly from Salesforce.
The integration provided advanced features such as intelligent search for matching patient records, real-time syncing, error handling, and a user-friendly interface accessible only to administrators. This seamless integration significantly reduced manual data entry errors and ensured up-to-date patient information across platforms.
01
Cross-System Data Synchronization
The objective was to gain the benefits of achieving  real-time data synchronization between Salesforce and the client’s patient management platform. By integrating two previously siloed systems, healthcare providers gained the ability to have accurate, up-to-date patient data readily available, eliminating administrative lag and improving patient service quality.
02
Leveraging Salesforce Apex for Custom Solutions
We used  Salesforce Apex to create a custom integration module, providing the flexibility needed to meet the client’s specific needs. Apex allowed for the creation of custom triggers, batch processing, and error handling, ensuring that the solution was scalable and reliable for the high volume of patient and contact data.
03
Simplified User Experience through Automation
MetaDesign Solutions prioritized user experience by incorporating a simple, administrator-friendly interface . Automating the syncing process reduced the learning curve for healthcare administrators and allowed them to handle complex tasks such as batch syncing with ease, making operations more efficient.
Results
The Salesforce integration module delivered by MetaDesign Solutions revolutionized the way the client managed their customer and patient data. By eliminating the need for manual entry, the solution significantly reduced errors, improved operational efficiency, and allowed healthcare practices to focus more on delivering patient care. The integration enabled real-time updates and simplified the process of managing thousands of records, helping the client maintain data integrity across both platforms. This solution continues to support their healthcare providers nationwide, making data synchronization an automated, reliable process.

headings.text: Developing a Word Add-in to streamline contract negotiation and collaboration for a global leader in business spend management, empowering users with real-time legal clause reviews, seamless document uploads, and collaborative workflows

pages.content:
By
Sukriti Srivastava
/
Developing a Word Add-in to streamline contract negotiation and collaboration for a global leader in business spend management, empowering users with real-time legal clause reviews, seamless document uploads, and collaborative workflows
Overview
MetaDesign Solutions successfully developed a robust Word 365 Add-in for a global leader in business spend management (BSM). The solution integrates with the client’s Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) platform, offering users features like real-time contract clause review, SSO-based authentication, and streamlined document uploads across desktop and mobile devices. The add-in has significantly improved contract negotiation processes by providing seamless integration with Office 365 and real-time data updates, helping the client’s users boost operational efficiency and reduce contract risks.
about the client
Our client is a leading global provider of cloud-based business spend management (BSM) solutions, helping companies optimize procurement, supply chain, and financial operations. The company’s platform manages trillions of dollars in business spend across various industries, including technology, healthcare, and manufacturing. Their Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) platform enables organizations to manage contract negotiations and executions with precision, providing automation, risk reduction, and intelligent analytics.
To enhance their digital transformation efforts, the client sought to improve user experience within their contract negotiation platform by integrating with Word 365. The goal was to empower users with seamless access to contract data, clause review, and real-time collaboration while maintaining a secure and compliant environment. This project was critical in furthering the company’s mission to deliver AI-powered solutions that streamline business operations.
Industry Domain
Technology
Service Category (Service-line)
Word Plug-in Development / Office Plug-in Development / Digital Product Development
Technologies Used
Angular
HTML5
CSS3
Office Add-in SDK
Challenges
Cross-platform integration : Ensuring compatibility across both desktop and online versions of Word 365 while maintaining performance consistency.
Real-time clause review : Implementing real-time legal clause suggestions through REST API integration with the CLM platform.
User authentication : Providing a seamless single sign-on (SSO) experience for users across multiple devices while managing session security and integrity.
Document versioning : Creating a solution that supports document uploads with conflict resolution features, preserving edit histories across internal and external parties.
Task pane flexibility : Building a task pane that can handle complex configurations, user roles, and document validation rules within Word.
Solution Scope and Services
MetaDesign Solutions was tasked with building a Word 365 Add-in that supported real-time contract collaboration and clause review through the client’s existing APIs. The add-in was developed using Angular for the frontend, ensuring a dynamic user experience, while the Office 365 Add-in SDK was used to integrate with Word’s API. The project involved SSO integration to ensure secure authentication across both Word Online and desktop versions. We also provided an intuitive task pane, enabling users to review, upload, and check-in contracts directly from Word.
The Add-in allows users to open documents from the CLM platform, make edits, and automatically update contract variables. It also provided conflict resolution features, ensuring that the uploaded document adheres to user permissions and retains an accurate version history. By hosting the solution on AWS via an S3 Bucket, we ensured the system’s scalability and reliability, supporting both mobile and desktop users.
01
Cross-platform Support for Word 365
The Add-in was developed to function seamlessly across both the desktop and online versions of Word 365. This ensured that users could access and collaborate on contract documents from anywhere, on any device, without facing compatibility issues. MetaDesign Solutions’ focus on building a flexible, responsive interface helped ensure consistency across platforms, providing users with a smooth, uninterrupted experience.
02
Real-time Contract Clause Review Using REST API
By integrating the client’s CLM platform with the Word Add-in, MetaDesign Solutions implemented a real-time clause review system powered by REST APIs. This feature provided immediate suggestions for legal clause changes, enabling faster and more informed contract negotiations. The integration of real-time data into the Word interface helped users enhance compliance and reduce risks.
03
Secure Authentication with SSO
To streamline user access and enhance security, the Add-in featured SSO integration. This allowed users to authenticate seamlessly across both desktop and web versions of Word, providing a smooth experience without compromising on security. The SSO feature ensured that users could switch between devices without needing to reauthenticate, improving overall productivity and user satisfaction.
Results
The Word Add-in developed by MetaDesign Solutions has enabled the client’s users to negotiate contracts more efficiently by providing an integrated platform for real-time clause review, secure document uploads, and seamless collaboration. The ability to edit, track, and resolve conflicts within the document directly from Word has streamlined the client’s contract management processes, significantly reducing negotiation time and improving user productivity. With seamless integration into the Office 365 environment, this solution has contributed to the client’s broader goals of digital transformation and operational excellence.

headings.text: MetaDesign Solutions successfully developed the Salesforce Adobe InDesign Connector, enabling seamless integration between Adobe InDesign and Salesforce

Enhanced Document Creation with Salesforce Data

pages.content:
By
Pooja Makkar
/
MetaDesign Solutions successfully developed the Salesforce Adobe InDesign Connector, enabling seamless integration between Adobe InDesign and Salesforce
Overview
MetaDesign Solutions has developed the Salesforce Adobe InDesign Connector, a powerful plug-in designed to streamline workflows between Salesforce and Adobe InDesign. The plug-in leverages Salesforce APIs and Adobe InDesign’s SDK to enable users to merge complex datasets into InDesign documents, enhancing productivity and reducing manual effort. Trusted by over 500+ customers, the connector allows users to create custom datasets, join multiple Salesforce objects, and mass merge data into documents, offering a comprehensive, easy-to-use solution.
about the client
MetaDesign Solutions, an innovative technology development company, has built this in-house product, the Salesforce Adobe InDesign Connector , to offer enhanced functionality for enterprises using Salesforce and Adobe InDesign. As a leading provider of digital solutions, MetaDesign Solutions aims to fill the gap between Salesforce CRM and creative workflows in InDesign, allowing businesses to leverage both platforms simultaneously without switching between systems.
The Salesforce Adobe InDesign Connector is a plug-in that empowers users by connecting Salesforce with Adobe InDesign through advanced integration features. Users can select fields from multiple Salesforce objects, create custom data sets, and merge this data into InDesign documents. The product enhances Salesforce’s capabilities by allowing complex queries, multiple datasets, and configuration-saving features, making it indispensable for businesses needing high-volume document creation.
Industry Domain
Technology
Service Category (Service-line)
InDesign Plug-in Development / Salesforce Development
Technologies Used
Adobe InDesign SDK
ReactJS
Salesforce API
Challenges
Complex Data Handling : Integrating Salesforce’s complex data structure into Adobe InDesign required handling data from multiple objects and relationships, such as adding joins and managing complex datasets.
Mass Data Merge : Supporting bulk merging of data and images from Salesforce into InDesign while maintaining system performance posed a significant technical challenge.
Custom Query Support : Providing users with the ability to create and save custom queries with multiple parameters, while ensuring a smooth experience within InDesign’s Data Merge and XML Merge features.
User Configuration Management : The need to allow users to save their settings and configurations for reuse was a challenging yet critical feature for enhancing productivity.
Seamless API Integration : Ensuring seamless and secure integration between Salesforce API and InDesign SDK to support a smooth user experience.
Solution Scope and Services
MetaDesign Solutions provided a comprehensive solution by developing the Salesforce Adobe InDesign Connector using the Adobe InDesign SDK and Salesforce API. The solution allows users to bridge the gap between Salesforce CRM data and Adobe InDesign, simplifying the merging of large datasets into design documents. The plug-in enables users to select fields from multiple objects, create data joins, and merge them into InDesign templates using built-in Data Merge functionality.
Additionally, the solution allows users to save configurations for repeated use, addressing the challenge of custom query creation. With advanced data handling features, including multi-object selection and custom queries, the plug-in has significantly streamlined document creation processes for businesses that require high-volume output.
01
Streamlined Data Handling with Multi-Object Integration
The Salesforce Adobe InDesign Connector allows users to seamlessly integrate complex data from multiple Salesforce objects into a single dataset. This functionality is powered by advanced query building features, enabling users to merge diverse fields and tables with ease. The result is an enhanced workflow that dramatically reduces manual effort and increases productivity.
02
Advanced Custom Query Creation and Configuration Saving
Users can create custom queries with multiple parameters to gather the exact data needed for their documents. The ability to save these configurations for future use ensures that users can efficiently replicate their workflows without the need for repeated data setup, saving time and effort.
03
Enhanced Document Creation with Salesforce Data
The plug-in supports InDesign’s powerful Data Merge and XML Merge features, making it easier for businesses to produce large volumes of documents by merging data directly from Salesforce. This functionality is particularly beneficial for industries that require the frequent generation of personalized or mass-marketing materials.
Results
The Salesforce Adobe InDesign Connector developed by MetaDesign Solutions has become an indispensable tool for over 500 customers worldwide, helping businesses improve productivity and streamline workflows. The solution’s advanced capabilities in data merging, custom query creation, and multi-object handling have made it a valuable asset for companies looking to integrate Salesforce CRM data with creative InDesign workflows.
By leveraging Salesforce API and Adobe InDesign SDK, the plug-in has successfully solved the challenges of complex data merges, enabling efficient document production at scale. MetaDesign Solutions continues to enhance the product, ensuring it meets the evolving needs of its users, further establishing its commitment to delivering high-quality digital solutions.

One of Atex's key offerings, the Adbase Suite, includes the AdSales CRM, which allows companies to manage advertising sales efficiently. Although Atex has since been divided, with NewsCycleSolutions now owning the Adbase product, the project was undertaken while the AdSales product was under Atex. The CRM solution within AdSales is critical for managing customer relationships, automating ad bookings, and improving overall advertising workflows.
Industry Domain
Technology, Media
Service Category (Service-line)
Outllok Add-in / Office Add-in Development / Digital Product Development
Technologies Used
C#
VSTO Add-in SDK
Microsoft Office SDK
Challenges
Diverse Customer Authentication : Each AdSales user had a unique web URL for CRM access, which meant the authentication process needed to handle variable input efficiently.
Cross-Platform Compatibility : The add-in had to work seamlessly on both Windows and Mac versions of Outlook, which involved ensuring compatibility across different environments.
Bi-Directional Event Syncing : Ensuring accurate and real-time bi-directional synchronization of events between Outlook and AdSales presented challenges in handling data conflicts and keeping both systems updated.
Streamlined Email Integration : Converting emails into tasks and syncing them with the appropriate AdSales contacts required a smooth workflow that avoided unnecessary steps for users.
Optimizing User Workflow : The goal was to minimize the need for sales and support personnel to manually transfer data between Outlook and AdSales, thus improving their efficiency.
Solution Scope and Services
MetaDesign Solutions developed a VSTO (Visual Studio Tools for Office) Add-in using C#.Net to integrate Microsoft Outlook with Atex’s AdSales CRM. The add-in allowed users to authenticate via their unique AdSales URLs, simplifying access to their CRM data directly from Outlook. With email syncing, users could convert important communications into actionable tasks, linking them directly to their CRM contact persons without leaving the email platform. The event-syncing feature provided bi-directional updates between Outlook and AdSales, ensuring all meetings and appointments remained in sync across platforms.
The scope of this project included ensuring full compatibility across both Windows and Mac desktop versions of Outlook. Given the hybrid work environments many media companies operate within, this cross-platform functionality ensured that users could access the add-in regardless of their preferred operating system.
01
Cross-Platform Outlook Integration
The development of the Outlook add-in included compatibility for both Windows and Mac versions. This allowed users on different platforms to access the same CRM functionality, ensuring a consistent experience across devices. This decision reduced onboarding friction and improved adoption rates among diverse teams.
02
Efficient CRM Workflow Automation
The syncing of emails as tasks and bi-directional event management ensured that users no longer had to switch between Outlook and AdSales. This reduced manual entry and prevented data loss, as every interaction within Outlook was synced with the CRM in real time, boosting operational efficiency.
03
Leveraging Microsoft’s VSTO SDK for Office Integration
Utilizing Microsoft’s VSTO SDK allowed MetaDesign Solutions to seamlessly integrate the add-in within Outlook’s native environment. This approach ensured the add-in ran smoothly within the Office ecosystem, providing users with an intuitive, hassle-free experience while accessing CRM features.
Results
The Microsoft Outlook Add-in developed for Atex’s AdSales CRM significantly enhanced the workflow for their sales and support teams. By allowing seamless email and event syncing, as well as task management directly within Outlook, the add-in reduced the need for manual data entry, saving time and improving productivity. The cross-platform solution provided consistent functionality for both Windows and Mac users, ensuring that the entire team could benefit from the integration. The project successfully addressed the business challenge of improving CRM accessibility, helping Atex’s clients streamline their advertising workflows.

headings.text: Enterprise software add ins for a leading Indian financial services company
Component 2: Office Add-ins supporting Desktop PC

pages.content:
By
Sukriti Srivastava
/
Enterprise software add ins for a leading Indian financial services company
Overview
The company is a leading financial services firm, founded in 2006 and has its headquarters in Mumbai India. With a team of 500 employees and customers across the country it is a growing business seeking standardization and consistency.
about the client
The business wanted to make sure that for all the documents its employees worked on, they would follow the same guidelines as agreed with their clients. So they started looking for a plugin for word, excel and powerpoint that could control the document templates according to the brand guidelines for its employees working on different projects.
Brand guidelines include font settings, color, chat styles, object styles etc. and all of those styles are to be pre-configured on the plugin and should restrict the user to only use the styles allowed by the brand for that project.
As there was no ready to use solution available, they decided to hire a development company and have it custom developed. They contacted MetaDesign Solutions and contracted us for the development of these plug-ins.
Industry Domain
Financial Services
Service Category (Service-line)
Value Added Services (Plugins)
Technologies Used
Microsoft Tools
Asp.Net
AWS
Challenges
The plugin should work on Word, Excel and Powerpoint.
It should retain the formatting when the data is copied between Word, Excel and Powerpoint.
It should restrict the user to use the style settings depending on the project he/she is working on.
The plug-in should integrate with active directory and fetch user profile details based on his AD user.
Admin Panel should be a web based application hosted on cloud.
Solution Scope and Services
The team at MetaDesign Solution came up with the solution that involved two components:
01
Component 1: Web based Admin
The functionality of web based admin was to allow admins to configure the users and different style settings and associate styles to different projects, and then those projects could be assigned to different users. To do this the web admin panel was integrated with an active directory for login. Web based admin panel is currently hosted on AWS in Mumbai. Admin panel was developed using Angular in the frontend and ASP.Net MVC for backend API.
02
Component 2: Office Add-ins supporting Desktop PC
The second component of the solution involved Add-ins for word, excel and powerpoint supporting desktop PC versions. User is identified based on his Active Directory profile. When the user starts any of his Office Applications such as Word, Excel or Powerpoint, a list of projects is fetched from the central admin application and shown to the user to select the project he wants to work upon. Based on the project selected, office application is configured to use the style settings defined for the application. If he is working on project xyz then the plugin will restrict him to only use the styling associated with xyz project in the admin panel. The Add-in also allows users to copy past items within office applications retaining style information.
Results
In its implementation , the new solution has resulted in better efficiency and accuracy.
The users are more efficient, they are able to save 40% of their time and are able to do more projects in the same amount of time. Now they are able to produce more accurate documents, which are in line with the brand guidelines of the customer. This has helped reduce the number of review cycles from 4 to 2. Thus, saving time for the client and employees.
The new plugin has also impacted the business in terms of reduced cost of doing a project and they are also able to reduce the time taken to complete a project, i.e., the same person can do more projects in the same amount of time. Accuracy level has also increased which is making it less painful for the customer to review the documents.

By
Pooja Makkar
